tools.name: generate_gemini_completion
tools.description: Generates text completions and structured reasoning across all 45 Google Gemini foundation models (Gemini 4 Argon, 3.1 Pro, 3.8 Flash) with zero Google account or API key required. Use when running single-turn reasoning, coding, or analytical prompts on a specific Gemini model; for delegating multi-step complex tasks that require remote tool execution, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-4-argon'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Primary user instruction or reasoning prompt to send to the selected Gemini model.

model.description: Target Gemini foundation model identifier; defaults to 'gemini-4-argon' when omitted.

annotations.title: Account-Less Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Universal Text Generator

tools.name: execute_antigravity_agent
tools.description: Dispatches a complex engineering or operational task to Google's Antigravity autonomous agent for multi-step planning, tool orchestration, and verified execution. Use when solving multi-stage software engineering or workflow tasks that require autonomous planning; for compiling exhaustive multi-source literature and market research dossiers, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('execution_mode' defaults to 'autonomous_verified'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (150 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: High-level task objective and constraints for the Antigravity autonomous agent.

execution_mode.description: Autonomy policy for subtask execution; defaults to 'autonomous_verified' when omitted.

annotations.title: Google Antigravity Multi-Step Autonomous Coding & Workflow Agent

tools.name: conduct_deep_research_investigation
tools.description: Runs an iterative, multi-hop investigative research session via Gemini Deep Research Pro, cross-examining primary sources to produce a cited technical report. Use when investigating complex scientific, architectural, or market questions requiring deep multi-hop synthesis; for running a fast single-turn Google Search grounded fact lookup, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('depth_tier' defaults to 'quick_synthesis'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: Investigative research question, scope, and specific aspects to analyze.

depth_tier.description: Research breadth and citation density; defaults to 'exhaustive_report' when omitted.

annotations.title: Gemini Deep Research Pro Multi-Hop Investigative Analyst

tools.name: operate_computer_use_agent
tools.description: Plans and executes OS-level desktop, browser DOM, and GUI coordinate actions (click, type, scroll, wait) using the Gemini Computer Use agent. Use when automating interactive web UIs or desktop workflows that lack a direct REST API; for running code-first API and terminal automation tasks, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('viewport_preset' defaults to 'desktop_1080p'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: UI automation goal and target webpage or application context.

viewport_preset.description: Target screen resolution for coordinate grounding; defaults to 'desktop_1080p' when omitted.

annotations.title: Gemini Computer Use GUI & Browser Action Planner

tools.name: search_gemini_grounded_web
tools.description: Answers factual queries with live Google Search grounding, returning verified up-to-date answers accompanied by source URLs and grounding metadata. Use when verifying live web facts, documentation updates, or current events in a single low-latency call; for querying geographic places, coordinates, directions, and local business data via Google Maps grounding, use search_gemini_grounded_maps instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('recency_bias' defaults to 'past_24h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Factual question or search query to ground against live Google Search results.

recency_bias.description: Temporal preference for search snippets; defaults to 'any_time' when omitted.

annotations.title: Google Search Grounded Real-Time Fact & Citation Engine

tools.name: search_gemini_grounded_maps
tools.description: Executes geospatial and point-of-interest queries grounded in live Google Maps data, returning verified addresses, coordinates, operating hours, and spatial context. Use when resolving physical locations, venues, transit distances, or regional infrastructure data; for searching general web articles, documentation, and news, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('distance_units' defaults to 'metric_km'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Geospatial query, place name, or regional routing question.

distance_units.description: Preferred unit system for distances; defaults to 'metric_km' when omitted.

annotations.title: Google Maps Grounded Geospatial & Place Intelligence Engine

tools.name: compile_mpp_research_dossier
tools.description: Compiles a structured JSON research dossier ('key_findings', 'synthesis_quality_score', 'sources_cited') settled via Base EVM Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). Use when generating a strict-JSON cited intelligence brief paid via Base USDC MPP session headers; for running long-form narrative research reports via L402 Lightning, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'research_topic' ('output_density' defaults to 'concise_5_points'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

query.description: Research topic or technical question to investigate and structure into JSON.

research_topic.description: Alias for query: research topic or technical question to investigate.

output_density.description: Granularity of the key_findings array; defaults to 'executive_10_points' when omitted.

annotations.title: Base MPP Session-Metered Multi-Source Research Dossier Compiler

tools.name: generate_gemini_embeddings
tools.description: Generates normalized 3,072-dimensional or 768-dimensional semantic vector embeddings via Google Gemini Embedding 2 for RAG indexing and cosine-similarity search. Use when embedding text passages or queries via L402 Lightning with configurable Matryoshka dimensions; for running live Google Search grounded factual queries, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-embedding-2'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

text.description: Input text passage, code snippet, or search query to embed into a float vector.

model.description: Gemini embedding model version; defaults to 'gemini-embedding-2' when omitted.

tools.name: analyze_omni_multimodal_input
tools.description: Analyzes combined multimodal prompts spanning text, image descriptors, audio transcripts, and video temporal events using Gemini Omni Flash. Use when correlating information across multiple media modalities in a single reasoning pass; for running pure text-only reasoning or coding prompts, use generate_gemini_completion instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('modality_focus' defaults to 'cross_modal_synthesis'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: Multimodal prompt or media scene description to analyze.

modality_focus.description: Primary analytical lens applied to the multimodal input; defaults to 'cross_modal_synthesis' when omitted.

annotations.title: Gemini Omni Unified Text, Audio & Video Multimodal Analyzer

tools.name: plan_robotics_spatial_trajectory
tools.description: Computes 3D spatial affordances, obstacle-avoidance waypoints, and manipulator grasp sequences using Gemini Robotics ER 2 embodied reasoning. Use when planning physical robot arm kinematics, mobile navigation waypoints, or spatial scene task orders; for interacting with 2D desktop or browser GUI screens, use operate_computer_use_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('coordinate_frame' defaults to 'cartesian_xyz_meters'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (150 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Spatial environment description, obstacle coordinates, and physical manipulation goal.

coordinate_frame.description: Reference coordinate convention; defaults to 'cartesian_xyz_meters' when omitted.

annotations.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Embodied Spatial & Kinematics Trajectory Planner

tools.name: generate_nano_banana_image
tools.description: Generates photorealistic illustrations, UI mockups, and technical diagrams from text prompts using the Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) model family. Use when creating static visual assets, icons, or architecture diagrams from text descriptions; for synthesizing animated multi-second video clips with motion, use generate_veo_cinematic_video instead. annotations.title: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini Image) Visual Asset & Diagram Generator

tools.name: generate_veo_cinematic_video
tools.description: Synthesizes high-definition cinematic video sequences with temporally coherent camera motion and physics using Google Veo 3. Use when generating moving video clips, product B-roll, or animated scene renders from text prompts; for rendering static single-frame images or diagrams at lower cost, use generate_nano_banana_image instead. tools.name: compose_lyria_music_track
tools.description: Composes studio-grade instrumental music tracks, ambient loops, and multi-instrument arrangements from genre, tempo, and mood prompts using Google Lyria 3. Use when generating musical scores, soundtrack stems, or rhythmic audio loops; for converting written text into spoken human voice narration (TTS), use synthesize_gemini_speech_audio instead. tools.name: synthesize_gemini_speech_audio
tools.description: Converts written text into natural, prosody-controlled spoken voice audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash Neural Text-to-Speech. Use when rendering voiceover narration or spoken agent replies from a deterministic text script; for conducting bidirectional conversational audio dialog comprehension, use process_live_audio_dialogue instead. annotations.title: Gemini Neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) Expressive Voice Synthesizer
